papers.title_en: NCCL M2N: A Layout- and Topology-Aware Collective for Distributed Tensor Resharding
papers.authors: Kaushik Kandadi, Youngeun Kwon, Sreeram Potluri, Ching-Hsiang Chu, Ke Wen, Pouya Kousha, Sangkug Lym, Nitin Nitin, Manjunath Gorentla Venkata
papers.evidence: 布局与拓扑感知的张量重分片集合通信原语
papers.tldr: 分布式训练与 rollout 的 tensor layout 不同，需要跨进程组重排权重，但标准 collective 无法直接表达这种 M-to-N 重分布。NCCL M2N 根据源与目的 mesh/placement 推导传输区域和全局调度，用分层路由在目的 NVLink 域间只转发一份数据，并让网络传输与本地复制重叠。在 256 张 GB200 上，单层 FFN-MoE 传输最高加速 7.9 倍，DeepSeek-V3 NeMo-RL 权重同步从 5.78 s 降到 2.77 s，step time 降低 12.7%。
papers.abstract_en: Distributed training and rollout generation often use different tensor layouts, requiring model weights to be resharded across distinct process groups. This M-to-N redistribution is not directly expressed by standard collectives. Flat direct sends duplicate traffic across destination replicas, while gather-then-broadcast concentrates network injection at one root and transfers data that destinations do not need. For DeepSeek-V3 on 256 GPUs, legacy all-gather plus broadcast accounts for 29.4% of the reported reinforcement-learning step time. We present NCCL M2N, a layout- and topology-aware collective primitive for distributed tensor resharding. Given source and destination meshes and placements, it derives the required transfer regions and a global communication schedule. Its hierarchical route balances source contributions across eligible destination ranks, forwards one copy between destination NVLink domains, and completes local replication over NVLink. Network transfer and local replication overlap, avoiding replica-multiplied source egress. An aggregate data-movement model captures the limits of both stages. We evaluate NCCL M2N on up to 256 GB200 GPUs in an NVL72 cluster with NDR InfiniBand. A single FFN-MoE layer transfer achieves up to 7.9x speedup over flat direct sends (9.8 ms versus 77.3 ms). In a separate 256-GPU DeepSeek-V3 NeMo-RL experiment, NCCL M2N reduces reported weight-sync time from 5.78 s to 2.77 s, a 2.09x speedup over legacy all-gather plus broadcast, and reduces step time by 12.7%.

papers.title_en: DualColl: Throughput-Optimal Bandwidth-Bound Collective Communications via Fractional Tree Packing
papers.evidence: 面向GPU集群、基于分数树打包的吞吐最优AllReduce集合通信算法
papers.tldr: 大规模分布式训练中 AllReduce 常受通信带宽限制，现有 ForestColl 需经 AllGather 与 ReduceScatter 组合间接处理。DualColl 直接面向带宽受限 AllReduce，采用 Garg–Könemann 乘法权重并设计精确最小代价 collective-tree oracle。对任意 ε，其调度吞吐至少达到最优的 (1−ε)^2，并扩展到 packet-sprayed 路由与无逐树带宽控制网络。该工作为异构 GPU 集群的高吞吐集合通信提供了可证明近似与更直接的构造。
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale distributed training increasingly makes collective communication bandwidth-bound. In modern GPU clusters, communication libraries such as NCCL implement collectives including AllReduce over heterogeneous interconnects such as NVLink, InfiniBand, and Ethernet, making efficient use of available network bandwidth a central systems challenge.   ForestColl showed that collective communication on such fabrics can be formulated using fractional tree packing; its scalable polynomial-time construction is developed for AllGather, with AllReduce obtained by composing AllGather and ReduceScatter. We present DualColl, which targets bandwidth-bound AllReduce directly. Under the tree-based AllReduce model, DualColl applies a Garg--Könemann-style multiplicative-weights algorithm and, for any $0<ε<1$, computes a feasible schedule whose throughput is at least $(1-ε)^2$ of the optimal AllReduce throughput. Its key component is an exact minimum-cost collective-tree oracle that projects physical-link dual prices onto a logical graph of participating ranks, reducing each iteration to shortest-path computations followed by a minimum spanning tree.   We further extend the framework to local equal-next-hop packet-sprayed routing and to networks without explicit per-tree bandwidth control. For the latter, we introduce a tree-coupled max-min bandwidth-sharing model and show that tree duplication approximates an explicit fractional allocation with a provable accuracy-complexity tradeoff. Finally, we extend the fractional-packing framework to additional collective operations and multiple concurrent collective groups.

papers.title_en: SP-Allreduce: Symmetric Tree Schedules for Tori and Beyond
papers.authors: Mikhail Cherniavskii, Andrey Kupavskii, Georgy Mironov, Stanislav Moiseev
papers.evidence: 面向环面拓扑的对称最短路径树allreduce新算法
papers.tldr: 大规模分布式训练依赖高效Allreduce，而环面互连仍广泛部署。SP-Allreduce利用d维环面拓扑对称性，仅沿最短路径构建对称化最短路径树，实现α-β模型下的全带宽最优。它证明在完全带宽最优算法中轮数最少，较Bucket将轮数减半；在方/矩形环面及HyperX、脊叶网络实验中最高取得1.19×、1.65×、14.82×和1.72×加速。该工作为环面及更广对称拓扑提供了更优通信调度方案。
papers.abstract_en: Allreduce is a fundamental communication primitive in large-scale distributed training, and torus interconnects remain widely deployed in high-performance systems. We introduce SP-allreduce, a new allreduce algorithm for $d$-dimensional tori that exploits the symmetry of the topology and routes only along shortest paths.   We call an allreduce algorithm \emph{fully bandwidth-optimal} if it incurs no bandwidth overhead, no multihop-induced traffic inflation, and achieves perfect per-round load balance. SP-allreduce is based on a family of carefully symmetrized shortest-path trees that guarantees full bandwidth optimality in the $α$--$β$ model. We prove that it uses the minimum possible number of rounds among all fully bandwidth-optimal allreduce algorithms on $d$-dimensional tori, and therefore the minimum running time in this class. In this sense, SP-allreduce refines Bucket allreduce: it preserves Bucket's key strengths while reducing the number of rounds by a factor of two.   We further extend our approach to broader symmetric topologies and to communication trees of prescribed depths. Experimentally, the resulting algorithms improve over the best compared state-of-the-art algorithms for tori by up to $1.19\times$ on square tori and $1.65\times$ on rectangular tori across the tested configurations. On HyperX and spine-leaf networks, we demonstrate gains of up to $14.82\times$ and $1.72\times$, respectively, over the best evaluated baselines.

papers.title_en: HOCCL: Offloading Collective Communication from GPU Cores to Accelerate Distributed Training
papers.authors: Yao Fei, Gongming Zhao, Hongli Xu, Jin Fang, Jiacheng Zhu, Shuo Xu, Kun Huang, Zhuolong Yu
papers.evidence: 将集合通信从GPU流多处理器卸载到DMA引擎以加速分布式训练
papers.tldr: 大模型分布式训练需要大量计算，而现有集合通信会占用流多处理器，与计算任务争抢核心资源，影响训练效率。HOCCL观察到通信可由DMA引擎驱动，提出零SM集合通信框架，通过流管理器维持算子时序、点对点执行器实现零SM传输、集合调度器编排传输以最大化带宽。实验显示其平均通信性能距当前最优仅约3%，同时消除近10%总GPU SM的通信占用，释放的资源用于计算后端到端训练吞吐最高提升5%。该工作证明通信卸载可在保持性能的同时释放算力，为分布式训练加速提供新思路。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model training involves massive computation on GPU streaming multiprocessors (SMs), the primary compute units of GPUs. Since SMs host specialized accelerators such as Tensor Cores, their efficient utilization is critical to training efficiency. Unfortunately, existing collective communication systems compete with computation for SMs, as they consume SMs for communication-related data movement and synchronization operations.   We observe that communication can, in principle, be driven by DMA engines, thereby eliminating SM involvement in communication. Based on this insight, we propose HOCCL, a zero-SM collective communication framework consisting of three components: a stream manager, a point-to-point (P2P) executor, and a collective scheduler. The stream manager preserves operator-level temporal ordering with other GPU kernels. The P2P executor enables zero-SM point-to-point communication, while the collective scheduler orchestrates P2P transfers to maximize bandwidth. Experiments show that HOCCL preserves near-peak communication performance, achieving within 3% of the state of the art on average, while eliminating communication occupancy on nearly 10% of total GPU SMs. By freeing SM resources for computation, HOCCL improves end-to-end training throughput by up to 5%.

papers.title_en: VarioPath: Workload-Aware All-to-All Communication for PCIe GPU Clusters
papers.authors: Yao Fei, Jin Fang, Size Zheng, Gongming Zhao, Hongli Xu, Jiacheng Zhu, Zhijing Xin
papers.evidence: 面向PCIe GPU集群的负载感知AlltoAllv调度
papers.tldr: 针对PCIe GPU集群在MoE推理中AlltoAllv受链路竞争和动态偏斜流量困扰的问题，VarioPath结合离线拓扑分析器与在线需求感知调度器：前者将无竞争传输模式记录为通道并利用拓扑对称性构建紧凑目录，后者把每次调用需求分解到通道序列。四平台最高256 GPU上平均较FAST快5.88倍、较DeepEP快1.72倍，并降低Qwen3与Wan2.1端到端延迟。
papers.abstract_en: AlltoAllv communication is a critical primitive in distributed large-model inference, particularly for mixture-of-experts (MoE) models. The growing adoption of PCIe GPU systems for cost-efficient inference makes AlltoAllv performance on these systems increasingly important. Without a dedicated scale-up interconnect (e.g., NVLink or Infinity Fabric), PCIe GPU systems carry both intra-node and inter-node traffic through the PCIe hierarchy, where concurrent transfers can contend for PCIe link bandwidth. This link contention, compounded by skewed traffic distributions and dynamic traffic demand, makes efficient AlltoAllv scheduling challenging. Existing approaches are either poorly suited to PCIe GPU systems or incur substantial schedule synthesis overhead that reduces their practicality in real-world deployments.   We present VarioPath, an efficient AlltoAllv scheduling framework for PCIe GPU systems. It combines an offline topology-aware analyzer with an online demand-aware scheduler. The analyzer records contention-free transfer patterns as AlltoAllv channels and exploits topology symmetry to build a compact catalog for efficient search. The online scheduler decomposes each AlltoAllv invocation's demand across a sequence of channels, adapting to rapidly changing and skewed traffic while incurring low planning overhead. Evaluation on four platforms (up to 256 GPUs) shows average AlltoAllv speedups of 5.88x over FAST and 1.72x over DeepEP. End-to-end experiments show that VarioPath reduces Qwen3 inference latency by up to 27.2% and Wan2.1 generation latency by 6.1%.

papers.title_en: Purlin: Separating Orchestration from the Datapath of Collectives
papers.authors: Osayamen Jonathan Aimuyo, Swapnil Gandhi, Christos Kozyrakis
papers.evidence: 将集合通信编排协议与数据通路分离的GPU集合通信框架
papers.tldr: 分布式推理依赖GPU集合通信，但现有实现把语义、编排和数据通路耦合，导致适配新硬件与定制负载的成本较高且难以复用。Purlin将集合通信抽象为输入输出布局与copy/reduce操作，用SNAC协议复用编排、由硬件相关Atom数据通路执行。在A100、H200、B200上，七种集合通信延迟最高提速5.14倍、带宽最高提升4.50倍，集成SGLang后服务与扩散生成性能也提升。其贡献在于解耦编排与数据通路，降低新硬件适配和通信定制成本并提升可移植性。
papers.abstract_en: Distributed inference depends on GPU collective communication that must keep pace with evolving hardware and specialized workloads. However, existing collective implementations often couple semantics, orchestration (where and when data moves), and the datapath (how data moves). This coupling makes it costly to adopt new hardware mechanisms and customize communication for applications. We present Purlin, a scale-up communication framework that separates these concerns. At the top of Purlin, we specify collectives as a naming of an input and output layout and a copy or reduction operation. In the middle, we introduce a shared orchestration protocol, Stage, Notify, And Consume (SNAC), which derives coordination from these specifications. Below SNAC sits a hardware-specific datapath we call Atom, which implements two key data movement primitives for collectives: copy and reduce. This separation lets us customize collectives and adopt new hardware mechanisms while reusing orchestration via SNAC. We evaluate Purlin on A100, H200, and B200 GPUs. Across seven collectives, Purlin achieves latency speedups of up to 5.14x and bandwidth improvements of up to 4.50x over baselines. Integrated into SGLang, Purlin improves offline LLM serving throughput and interactivity by 1.13x on average and up to 1.37x over baselines. For online LLM inference, Purlin improves interactivity by 1.26x on average and up to 2.85x, with the largest gain occurring under overload. For diffusion image generation, Purlin reduces end-to-end latency by up to 1.13x.

papers.title_en: Joint Effects of GPU Server Topology, Parallelism, and Congestion Control on MoE Inference: A Controlled Simulation Study
papers.authors: Kaikai Yuan, Rui Xi, Yu Liu
papers.evidence: 服务器拓扑、TP/EP划分与拥塞控制对基于集合通信的MoE推理时间的影响
papers.tldr: 混合专家模型跨GPU推理包含张量并行集合通信与专家并行分发合并，完成时间受逻辑并行组到服务器互连、GPU网卡连接和跨节点网络的映射影响。研究用ASTRA-sim与NS-3在32卡、数据与流水并行固定为一的条件下，对六种拓扑、四种张量/专家划分、两种集合算法和四种网络拥塞控制做768次确定性仿真。反馈子集中暴露通信占平均完成时间89.9%至95.8%，TP16EP2耗时是TP2EP16的3.68至4.35倍，DBT比Ring多28.3%至83.2%。结果表明拓扑、并行划分、集合实现与拥塞控制需联合调优，额外GPU或网卡仅在秩映射均衡注入路径时有益。
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models expand capacity via sparse activation, but inference across GPUs introduces tensor-parallel (TP) collectives and expert-parallel (EP) dispatch and combine operations. Completion time depends not just on communication volume but on how logical groups map onto intra-server interconnects, GPU--NIC connections, and the inter-node network. Using ASTRA-sim with the NS-3 discrete-event backend, we build a controlled matrix of 32 GPU ranks with data and pipeline parallelism fixed at one. Workloads are fixed-length 4096-token prefill-like synthetic Chakra traces from four MoE configurations. Experiments cover six server topologies, four TP/EP partitions, two TP collective algorithms, and four network/congestion-control modes, yielding 768 deterministic simulations. In the 144-configuration feedback-enabled subset per model, exposed communication accounts for 89.9%--95.8% of mean completion time. TP16EP2 requires 3.68--4.35x the mean completion time of TP2EP16. With fixed rank mapping, ASTRA-sim Double Binary Tree (DBT) incurs 28.3%--83.2% more time than Ring. InfiniBand-like High Precision Congestion Control (HPCC) is ~0.9% lower than HPCC over RDMA over Converged Ethernet (RoCE), whereas RoCE with Data Center Quantized Congestion Notification (DCQCN) is 23.8%--35.7% slower than RoCE HPCC. Topology effects are conditional: Topology~6 leads at low TP degrees but loses its advantage at high TP degrees, and additional GPUs or NICs help only when rank mapping balances traffic across injection paths. Under uniform 32-way sharding, the largest checkpoint-weight shard is ~48.75 GB per rank, so all configurations meet a 64 GB per-accelerator weight-residency criterion. Within the evaluated workload and simulator semantics, server topology, parallelism, collective implementation, and congestion control jointly determine exposed communication and completion time.

papers.title_en: T-CCL: Resource Efficient and Performant Collective Communication using Tensor Memory Accelerator
papers.authors: Keyvan Dadashzadeh, Yuehong Zhou, Minyu Cui, Miquel Pericas
papers.evidence: 基于张量内存加速器的多GPU集合通信库
papers.tldr: 多GPU大模型训练推理需频繁集合通信，现有库常占用大量SM线程资源，影响并发计算。T-CCL面向节点内通信，将数据搬移与归约卸载到TMA，并以流水线异步TMA操作实现AllReduce、AllGather和ReduceScatter。在受限资源下最高较NCCL快3.42倍，GEMM重叠与vLLM推理吞吐也获提升。其价值在于兼顾高带宽与低SM占用，为通信计算重叠释放资源。
papers.abstract_en: Large transformer-based models increasingly depend on multi-GPU execution, which requires frequent collective communication among GPUs. Existing communication libraries often rely on many GPU threads to achieve high bandwidth or low latency, resulting in a large streaming multiprocessor (SM)-side resource footprint. This footprint can limit the resources available to other GPU work, particularly when communication and computation execute concurrently. Thus, efficient collective communication should not only achieve high collective performance but also reduce its SM-side resource usage. This paper presents T-CCL, a resource-efficient collective communication library based on the Tensor Memory Accelerator (TMA) for intra-node communication. T-CCL offloads both data movement and reduction operations to TMA and executes each collective as a pipelined series of asynchronous TMA operations, reducing the SM resources required for collective communication while maintaining high bandwidth. Evaluated across AllReduce, AllGather, and ReduceScatter collectives, T-CCL outperforms NCCL by up to 2.4x with unrestricted communication resources and up to 3.42x under restricted resource budgets, remains competitive with NCCL's recent symmetric-memory kernels, and occupies the same or fewer SMs in profiled cases. In a GEMM-collective overlap case study, switching the communication backend from NCCL to T-CCL raises the average operator-level speedup over a sequential baseline from 1.12x to 1.25x on two GPUs and from 1.04x to 1.14x on four GPUs, as T-CCL uses fewer SMs for communication, leaving more SMs available to the overlapped GEMM. Integrated into vLLM as a communication backend, T-CCL improves end-to-end inference throughput over vLLM's automatic backend dispatch by up to 1.31x, outperforming it at every evaluated batch size on both the conversation and decode-heavy workloads.

papers.title_en: Ofan: Optimal Load Balancing for AI Training
papers.authors: Sarah McClure, Evyatar Cohen, Jakob Krebs, Alexander Shpiner, Mark Silberstein, Scott Shenker, Sylvia Ratnasamy, Isaac Keslassy
papers.evidence: 面向AI训练集合完成时间的交换机端目的感知负载均衡与排队优化
papers.tldr: AI训练对集合通信完成时间要求极高，现有packet spraying在满线速下难以高效负载均衡。论文指出胖树中目的无关方案无法纠正上行选路造成的不平衡，并证明可产生Θ(√m)排队。为此提出交换机侧目的感知的Ofan及适配流水线架构的pOfan，实现O(1)排队。FSDP2与Llama-3 405B评估显示CCT膨胀降低16–39倍。
papers.abstract_en: The extreme collective completion time (CCT) demands of AI workloads challenge existing packet spraying algorithms, which can have trouble efficiently load-balancing workloads that are sent at full line rates.   We trace this to a structural cause: on a fat tree, once a packet picks its upward path, the downward path to its destination is unique, so destination-oblivious schemes cannot undo the imbalance it creates. We prove that such schemes can suffer from $Θ(\sqrt{m})$ queueing for messages of size $m$, thus eventually triggering rate reductions by the congestion control. Instead, we suggest Ofan, a switch-based destination-aware LB scheme that can reach $O(1)$ queueing. We also present its pOfan variant that fits the pipe-based architecture of current switches. Our P4 implementation shows that it consumes modest resources. An end-to-end FSDP2 evaluation with Llama-3 405B-parameter models shows that Ofan cuts CCT inflation by $16$--$39\times$ when compared to existing algorithms.

papers.title_en: Deploying RDMA for Distributed Inference and Training At Scale
papers.authors: Yibo Huang, Yi Cui, Yukai Huang, Huaping Zhou, Jiancong Tong, Zhaoyu Wu, Gen Miao, Haoran Wei, Boyan Ding, Zhuo Jiang, Jianxi Ye, Yibo Zhu, Chuanxiong Guo, Yang Xu, Jie Wu
papers.evidence: 为分布式训练与推理部署低延迟RDMA传输层
papers.tldr: 分布式机器学习可用RDMA降低通信开销，但生产部署仍受变长消息、并发连接、突发incast和故障恢复制约，仅靠硬件卸载不够。ByteExpress在硬件RDMA上构建软件通信层，集成RDMA感知分配器、零拷贝、QP复用、接收信用流控、软件发送窗口与RPC辅助恢复。生产推理参数拉取平均和P99延迟分别降35.7%和43.7%，CPU降10.69%；训练参数推送P99最多降74.0%，未见PFC暂停。其经验强调跨层缓冲管理、连接与接收容量协同及传输层以上恢复。
papers.abstract_en: RDMA can reduce communication overhead in distributed machine learning systems, but realizing these benefits in production requires more than replacing TCP. Variable-size messages, concurrent connections, bursty incasts, and service failures introduce challenges that hardware offload alone cannot address. This paper reports our experience deploying ByteExpress, a software communication layer over hardware RDMA, in ByteDance's parameter-server-based inference and training systems. We present three lessons from the deployment: efficient RDMA requires buffer management across application and transport layers; scalable communication requires coordinated management of connections, receive capacity, and outstanding data; and service availability requires recovery above the transport layer. ByteExpress combines an RDMA-aware allocator, zero-copy transfers, QP multiplexing, receive-credit flow control, a software send window, and RPC-assisted recovery. In production inference, ByteExpress reduces mean and P99 model parameter fetch latency by 35.7% and 43.7%, respectively, and total CPU usage by 10.69% compared with kernel TCP. In training, ByteExpress reduces P99 model parameter push latency by up to 74.0% compared with TCP, with no PFC pauses observed at runtime.

papers.title_en: PCM: Programmable Congestion Management for Terabit RDMA NICs
papers.authors: Mikhail Khalilov, Timo Schneider, Tommaso Bonato, Siyuan Shen, Marcin Chrapek, Yehor Kozyr, Alberto Merino, Rip Sohan, Surendra Anubolu, Mohan Kalkunte, Ahmad Ghalayini, Abdul Kabbani, Torsten Hoefler
papers.evidence: 面向数据中心RDMA网卡的可编程拥塞控制与负载均衡
papers.tldr: 数据中心拥塞控制与负载均衡策略快速演进，但RDMA网卡依赖厂商接口，策略跨平台移植困难。PCM将可移植拥塞管理逻辑与平台集成解耦，以事件驱动处理器、流遥测信号和触发器编写策略，并由厂商后端映射到原生机制。作者实现11种CC/LB算法并部署于四类数据通路；在CX-8上PCM-Swift以1/5硬件线程达到每三个4KiB包一次反应，在UCCL匹配原生Swift的1.56Tbit/s有效吞吐。其设计还影响了Ultra Ethernet可移植拥塞管理接口。
papers.abstract_en: Datacenter congestion control (CC) and load balancing (LB) evolve rapidly as workload demands change, but deployment depends on RDMA hardware and transport interfaces. Emerging programmable RDMA engines tie policy code to vendor APIs. Operators must therefore port each policy for every platform they deploy. We address this with PCM, a programming model that separates portable congestion management from platform integration on datacenter NICs. Developers write event-driven handlers that they can debug in simulation and reuse on real hardware. PCM exposes flow telemetry as signals and uses triggers to support per-event reactions and coarser responses to accumulated feedback. Vendors provide optimized backends that map signals and output controls to native NIC mechanisms with defined feedback and control semantics. We demonstrate PCM's expressivity by implementing eleven well-known datacenter CC and LB algorithms. We deploy PCM across four distinct datapaths: an Ultra Ethernet simulator, CPU-based UCCL, and on-NIC offloads on NVIDIA ConnectX-8 and Microsoft 1P. On CX-8, PCM-Swift achieves processing capacity equivalent to one reaction per three 4 KiB packets at 800 Gbit/s, using one-fifth of the NIC's hardware threads. In UCCL, it matches native Swift's 1.56 Tbit/s goodput with 64 KiB chunk-level control. PCM's design informed ongoing Ultra Ethernet work toward a portable congestion management interface.

papers.authors: Michele Ferrero, Gabriele Castellano, Paolo Medagliani, Sebastien Martin, Roberto Morabito, Massimo Gallo
papers.evidence: 基于测量并动态合成调度的集合通信库
papers.tldr: 大规模分布式训练中集体通信是关键瓶颈，现有库按静态拓扑和峰值链路一次性生成开环调度，难以应对生产环境持续数小时的灰色故障。MCCL 将运行时网络测量与动态调度合成闭环：被动测量 GPU 间吞吐、检测持续退化，并用热启动合成器重合成受影响调度后热切换。硬件原型与仿真显示其开销低于2%、测量误差低于1.2%、热切换约12毫秒；灰故障下相较静态调度最多缩短训练时间4.99倍。该工作提升了生产环境集体通信调度的鲁棒性。
papers.abstract_en: Collective communication is a critical performance bottleneck in large-scale distributed training. Existing libraries and synthesis frameworks compute open-loop schedules once, assuming a static topology and peak link capacities. In production, however, persistent gray failures can silently degrade link throughput and latency for hours, causing pre-computed schedules to lose much of their efficiency during execution. In this paper, we present Measurement-based Collective Communication Library (MCCL), a collective communication library that closes the loop between runtime network measurement and dynamic schedule synthesis. MCCL passively measures GPU-to-GPU throughput, detects persistent degradation, re-synthesizes the affected communication-intensive schedules with warm-started synthesizers, and hot-swaps them without interrupting training. We validate the complete loop on a multi-node hardware prototype and use simulations to evaluate cluster-scale scenarios. In our experiments, MCCL incurs negligible overhead (<2%) while maintaining high measurement accuracy (<1.2% error) and low schedule hot-swap time (about 12 ms). Notably, under gray failures, MCCL reduces training time by up to 4.99x over static schedules on simulated training workloads for state-of-the-art LLMs such as Llama and DeepSeek.

papers.title_en: Balancing Generality and Specialization: A Survey on AI Datacenter Hardware Architecture
papers.authors: Yufeng Gu, Jiazhen Wang, Reetuparna Das
papers.evidence: 支撑集合通信的AI数据中心互连架构
papers.tldr: AI负载快速增长正推动AI数据中心大规模投资。该综述将工业AI加速器划分为四类架构，比较其计算与内存组织，并考察节点、机架和集群级互连对集合通信的支持，追踪跨代架构演进。文章把算术吞吐提升与精度、数据交付、执行协调、通信、供电和冷却的变化联系起来，揭示通用性与专用化权衡从单加速器延伸到数据中心级系统。
papers.abstract_en: Rapidly growing AI workloads are driving large investments in AI datacenters. This survey classifies industrial AI accelerators into four architectural categories and compares their compute and memory organizations. It examines how node-, rack-, and pod-scale interconnects support collective communication, and traces architectural evolution across accelerator generations. The analysis connects advances in arithmetic throughput with changes in precision, data delivery, execution coordination, communication, power delivery, and cooling. It also discusses future design challenges arising from workload diversity, data movement, infrastructure constraints, and model evolution, showing how the trade-off between generality and specialization extends from individual accelerators to datacenter-scale systems. GitHub: github.com/Yufeng98/AI-datacenter

papers.title_en: AutoLoCo: Communication Efficient Distributed LLM Training via Adaptive Synchronization
papers.authors: Pengyu He, Yan Zhang, Ruien Li, Guangwen Yang
papers.evidence: 面向跨数据中心大模型训练的通信高效自适应同步
papers.tldr: 大模型跨数据中心预训练中，同步通信占比随加速器规模上升，固定本地更新间隔难以适应训练阶段变化。AutoLoCo 利用标量训练统计自适应调整本地优化步数，并针对间隔变化导致的外层优化器失配，用累计内层学习率校正动量与学习率。在通信受限实验中，它较 DiLoCo 降低 27% 通信频率且保持训练性能。该工作为分布式 LLM 训练提供了更通信高效的 adaptive synchronization 方案。
papers.abstract_en: The pre-training of Large Language Models (LLMs) is increasingly conducted across multiple data centers. As training scales to a larger number of accelerators, the fraction of time spent on computation decreases, while the fraction spent on communication increases. Therefore, frequent synchronization becomes a growing bottleneck. Local update methods reduce this cost by allowing workers to perform several optimizer steps between synchronizations. Most local update methods set the number of local optimizer steps between synchronizations before training and keep this interval fixed throughout the run. However, the best interval can change during the entire train process. If the interval and optimizer are adapted to the current training state, the communication frequency is reduced while maintaining the training performance. In this work, we introduce AutoLoCo, an adaptive training framework to reduce communication in LLM training. It adapts the local interval using scalar training statistics and corrects each outer update. Our method is motivated by two observations: 1) the appropriate local interval varies across training stages, and 2) changing the number of inner steps per interval creates a mismatch with an unchanged outer optimizer, requiring a correction to the outer update. We optimize this mismatch by correction of the outer optimizer for the momentum and the learning rate using the accumulated inner learning rate. Our experiments under communication constraints demonstrate that AutoLoCo reduces communication frequency by 27% relative to DiLoCo while maintaining training performance.

papers.title_en: Memory-Efficient Expert Routing for Distributed MoE Training
papers.authors: Arnab Kanti Tarafder, Jaume Guasch-Martí, Gokcen Kestor, Jie Ren
papers.evidence: 环形执行替代分布式MoE训练中的单步all-to-all派发
papers.tldr: MoE模型扩展至数百专家和高top-k路由时，分布式训练峰值内存受限于MoE块，标准all-to-all需一次性构造完整top-k扩展缓冲区。RelayMoE采用环式专家/令牌路由，按通信量选择路由方式并重叠传输与计算，反向时逐跳重算并释放专家中间量。在30B–57B生产模型上，单层MoE平均加速2倍，同显存预算下吞吐最高提升2.02倍，可训练序列长度最高扩展2.85倍。该工作以内存高效执行与重计算缓解MoE训练瓶颈，支持更长序列和更大批次。
papers.abstract_en: As Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models scale toward hundreds of experts and higher top-$k$ routing, memory efficiency in distributed training becomes a critical bottleneck. Peak memory is dominated by the MoE block, not attention: every intermediate buffer in the MoE dispatch pipeline is individually scaled by top-k routing. The standard all-to-all dispatcher sends all routed tokens in a single collective step, requiring the full top-$k$-expanded buffer to be constructed at once. In this work, we propose RelayMoE, a ring-based MoE execution model that computes locally as expert weights or tokens circulate, avoiding full top-$k$-expanded dispatch buffers. RelayMoE selects between expert and token routing according to communication volume and overlaps transfers with computation. The ring structure naturally supports memory-efficient MoE recomputation during backward: each hop reconstructs expert intermediates, uses them to compute gradients, and releases them before the next hop. The saved memory supports longer sequences and larger batches, or retains more attention activations to reduce attention recomputation and improve training throughput. We evaluate RelayMoE on 30B$-$57B production MoE models and varied expert configurations. In single-layer MoE experiments, RelayMoE achieves a $2\times$ average speedup over Megatron-LM. In full-model training under the same GPU memory budget, it improves throughput by up to $2.02\times$ and extends the largest tested trainable sequence length by up to $2.85\times$.

papers.title_en: Accelerating MoE Training through Expert Placement and Replica Coordination
papers.authors: Zhiqiang Tan, Maoxin Wang, Wenxiang Lin, Sijie Wang, Qiang Wang, Shaohuai Shi, Bo Li
papers.evidence: MoE训练中全对全通信与专家放置的联合优化
papers.tldr: MoE分布式训练受动态路由带来的负载不均和all-to-all通信瓶颈制约，现有去重、专家放置与复制未联合刻画负载语义。PlaceMoE联合优化专家布局与源感知的token到副本映射，结合分组、动态规划与交替精化，并重叠副本梯度同步与注意力反向。在32-GPU和64-NPU集群上，A2A通信最高加速6.94倍，端到端训练较VeOmni加速1.74-2.33倍。
papers.abstract_en: Distributed training of sparsely activated mixture-of-experts (MoE) models is often bottlenecked by workload imbalance and all-to-all (A2A) communication induced by dynamic token routing. Existing token deduplication, expert placement, and replication techniques alleviate these bottlenecks but do not jointly capture their distinct load semantics. Under hierarchical token deduplication, communication counts each token once per destination group at each hierarchy level, whereas expert computation processes every token-expert assignment. With replication, both costs depend jointly on physical layout and token-to-copy mapping, making separate optimization suboptimal. We present PlaceMoE to address this coupling. First, we formulate the joint optimization of expert layout and source-aware token-to-copy mapping for E experts distributed across P devices, accounting for both hierarchical communication traffic and expert-compute load. Second, we develop a solver that combines co-selection-aware expert grouping, bounded dynamic programming for replica allocation, and alternating refinement of layout and mapping. Third, PlaceMoE overlaps replica-gradient synchronization with attention backward. We evaluate PlaceMoE on a 32-GPU cluster and a 64-NPU cluster using Qwen3-VL and DeepSeek-V3. Experimental results show that PlaceMoE achieves up to a 6.94x speedup in A2A communication and 1.74-2.33x speedups in end-to-end training over the state-of-the-art training framework VeOmni.

papers.title_en: A New Lens on Multi-GPU Communication: API-Level Memory Models for Portable Optimization
papers.authors: Johnathan Alsop, Bradford Beckmann, Brandon Potter, Jiakun Yan, Aurelien Bouteiller, Omri Mor, Tony Tye, Sameer Sahasrabuddhe
papers.evidence: 多GPU集合通信库中设备端put/get原语的内存模型
papers.tldr: 多GPU通信日益成为ML/HPC瓶颈，设备端put/get等底层API虽可细粒度优化，却缺乏严格内存模型，易导致脆弱和兼容性问题。本文提出面向设备通信API的API级内存模型，并在rocSHMEM中定义设备侧通信语义，通过形式化松弛支持网络数据缓存绕过。更新SHMEM API后，集合通信、融合计算通信和专家并行负载分别最高提速2.48倍、1.77倍和1.18倍，为可移植优化提供标准化接口。
papers.abstract_en: As network communication increasingly becomes a performance bottleneck for ML and HPC workloads, it is more important than ever to optimize multi-GPU data transfers. Recently, low-level device APIs have emerged that allow programmers to perform fine-grain optimizations via one-sided put/get operations triggered directly from the device. However, the communication libraries providing these device APIs (e.g., rocSHMEM, MSCCL++, and NCCL/RCCL GIN) currently lack a rigorous memory model defining how their primitives interact with the underlying memory systems. Without this, emerging HPC and ML workloads aggressively optimizing network communication via device APIs can be brittle, error-prone, and face compatibility and inter-operability challenges.   This paper proposes the use of API-level memory models for these emerging device communication APIs. An API-level memory model defines the memory semantics of communication API calls in a way that abstracts lower-level details from the API user and simplifies development. This work defines one such model for device-side communication (implemented in AMD's recently open sourced rocSHMEM library) and demonstrates how formal relaxations to such a model can enable low-level LLM performance optimizations while retaining a well-defined standardized interface. Specifically, we describe how updating the SHMEM API implemented by rocSHMEM can properly support cache bypassing for network data, improving performance of a collective communication workload by up to 2.48x, a fused compute+communication workload by up to 1.77x, and a state-of-the-art expert-parallel communication workload by up to 1.18x.

papers.title_en: TopoEP: Topology-Aware Load Balancing for Expert-Parallel MoE Training
papers.authors: Jiacheng Zhu, Xie Zhao, Gongming Zhao, Hongli Xu, Yao Fei, Jin Fang
papers.evidence: 考虑分层集群通信代价的拓扑感知负载均衡
papers.tldr: 大规模MoE专家并行训练中，动态路由造成严重负载不均，托管热点专家的GPU成为拖慢每层同步的掉队者。TopoEP将每层与每个微批的路由结果在GPU上直接转化为热点专家复制和token重路由决策，无需依赖主机同步。其确定性GPU求解器先跨节点放置、再节点内细化，使各rank独立生成逐位一致的均衡计划。在32卡H800集群上集成Megatron-LM，三个代表性MoE模型端到端吞吐提升6.2%–11.4%。
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic routing creates severe load imbalance in large-scale expert-parallel Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) training, turning GPUs that host hot experts into stragglers. As each MoE layer waits for its slowest rank, these stragglers prolong the expert-parallel stage and reduce overall training efficiency. Existing expert-parallelism load-balancing (EPLB) systems commonly compute load-balancing plans on the CPU, incurring device--host data transfers and cross-rank synchronization that make scheduling at every layer and microbatch expensive. Their planning formulations also overlook the hierarchical communication costs of modern scale-up and scale-out GPU clusters.   We present \textit{TopoEP}, a GPU-native, topology-aware load-balancing system for large-scale MoE training. At each MoE layer and training microbatch, \textit{TopoEP} converts the current routing result into hot-expert replication and token-rerouting decisions and executes the resulting plan without data-dependent host synchronization, reducing critical-path overhead. To generate these decisions, \textit{TopoEP} uses a deterministic GPU solver that performs inter-node placement followed by intra-node refinement, allowing all ranks to independently produce bitwise-identical plans. On a 32-GPU NVIDIA H800 cluster, integrating \textit{TopoEP} with Megatron-LM improves end-to-end training throughput by 6.2\%--11.4\% across three representative MoE models.

papers.title_en: Zepp: Accelerating Distributed MoE Serving under Relaxed Balance Constraints
papers.authors: Chang Chen, Andrew Yang, Tiancheng Chen, Jiangfei Duan, Xinwei Qiang, Zhongkai Yu, Xiang Fang, Yufei Ding
papers.evidence: 面向GPU与网卡的分布式MoE服务瓶颈通信优化
papers.tldr: MoE服务依赖专家并行扩展，但专家负载倾斜导致计算、通信与内存失衡，传统以负载均衡为目标会引入额外开销。Zepp把均衡降为GPU/NIC资源约束，直接优化瓶颈通信，并在专家放置、路由与执行三阶段逐步优化。评测相对7个先进系统最高6.68倍MoE层加速，几何平均1.86倍。该工作表明松弛均衡约束可换取更高效的整体执行。
papers.abstract_en: As Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models continue to scale, serving them increasingly relies on expert parallelism (EP) across a growing number of devices. Yet skewed expert workloads create imbalance across computation, communication, and memory, making load balancing a central optimization objective in distributed MoE serving. We observe that balance is not free: operations introduced to balance one dimension can themselves be expensive or imbalanced. This motivates us to rethink balance as a constraint rather than an optimization objective. We present Zepp, which directly optimizes the bottleneck communication in distributed MoE serving subject to simplified balance constraints on physical resources, i.e., GPUs and NICs. Zepp progressively optimizes inter-node communication across placement, routing, and execution. It first places expert replicas to reduce token communication under GPU constraints, then reshapes communication flows through split and merge primitives under NIC constraints, and finally partitions and schedules ex- pert computation to overlap the resulting communication. To adapt to dynamic workloads, Zepp jointly coordinates computation, token communication, and expert-weight movement at each iteration. Together, these designs allow Zepp to pursue the most efficient execution rather than a single-dimension balanced one. We implement Zepp and evaluate it against 7 state-of-the-art MoE serving systems, achieving up to 6.68$\times$ MoE layer speedup and a geometric mean speedup of 1.86$\times$ over the fastest competing baseline.
